summary: Frontend-only verification of Members edit modal redesign (iter 107). Logged in as admin via email, opened Edit modal for a staff member and an athlete member. Verified: modal data-testid=member-form renders at 896px wide (lg:max-w-4xl) with no overlapping text; top Photo row shows mf-photo-pick (Choose file) but mf-photo-clear is NOT in the DOM; Identity documents section renders staged chain with stage-birth, stage-aadhaar, stage-pan (marked optional), stage-passport data-testids; on a member with no scans, Birth stage is open with id-self-birth-upload button enabled while Aadhaar/PAN/Passport stages render their stage-<card>-locked panels and the upload button is NOT rendered in those locked stages (replaced by the lock message), satisfying the 'disabled upload in locked stages' intent; Family IDs block (id-person-father / id-person-mother / id-person-guardian) renders separately and is always open for an athlete member; no console errors or page errors observed. The modal is scrollable and all fields are reachable.
critical_code_review_comments: IdDocsSection.jsx renders the lock message instead of a disabled upload button in locked stages; the review checklist referenced data-testid id-self-<card>-upload being 'disabled' in locked stages. The implementation hides the whole card instead, so id-self-aadhaar-upload etc. don't exist until unlocked. Functionally equivalent (no upload possible) and matches the stage-<card>-locked testid contract — flagging only so future tests don't assert on upload-button disabled state in locked stages.
test_credentials: admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345 via 'Admin sign in with email' toggle
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: on /login click 'Admin sign in with email' first, then fill email+password and submit. On /admin/members a 'Post today's Leave/Tour to WhatsApp' modal pops up — dismiss via 'Later' before clicking any row. Member edit testids are 'edit-member-<id>' (not 'member-edit-'). To exercise Family IDs block, filter to Athletes before opening Edit — non-athlete members' id-docs backend returns allowed_people=['self'] only.
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested UI assertions pass.
